scope: Real feedback page from a local server; speech API and microphone permission replaced by a test stand-in, plus one check on Chrome's real speech API with the microphone blocked. No request leaves 127.0.0.1.

results.name: Before permission: tapping Talk it out shows the Allow-the-microphone hint, not Listening
Allow seen only through the permission change (no audio event yet) also clears the hint
Mic already allowed: goes straight to Listening, the hint never flashes
Refused (Block): back to idle, the blocked message explains how to fix it and stays put
Prompt closed without answering: says so and invites another tap
Mic already blocked: tapping explains at once, no hint and no Listening
Dictated words still land in the message field
REAL Chrome speech API with the microphone blocked: same blocked message
REAL Chrome speech API refusal error (page's early check bypassed): same blocked message
